title: Hinduri language
text: Hinduri, also spelled Handuri, is a Western Pahari language of the Indo-Aryan branch within the Indo-European family, spoken primarily by indigenous communities in the Mandi region and Nalagarh areas of Himachal Pradesh, northern India.
